series_name: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
title: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
synopsis: A shady self-proclaimed hermit named Momoyuki Mogura, AKA: Mogura, is banned from the afterlife due to an incident. Now he collects spirit possessed will-o'-wisps in his lantern, hoping to make a comeback.
